questionText: What configuration did Spring require before Spring Boot existed?

target.learningOutcome: The learner can describe explicit Spring application assembly before Boot without incorrectly claiming that every application required XML or web.xml.
outOfScope: Claiming annotation configuration began with Boot

claims.statement: Without Boot, an application can use XML or Java configuration but must explicitly arrange dependency versions, infrastructure, startup, and deployment choices.
Boot uses starters, SpringApplication, and conditional auto-configuration to supply a common application setup while retaining user configuration and extension points.

examples.title: Historical servlet registration and Java MVC configuration compared with Boot

validation.expected: The historical example is labelled as one common approach rather than a universal pre-Boot requirement

visuals.title: Explicit application assembly and the Boot common path

notes: The unsupported claim about a fixed number of removed configuration lines was deleted.

review.notes: Historical boundaries and Boot 3.3.1 behavior were reviewed against official Spring documentation; visual and final editorial review remain open.
